carno.title: Car No.
carno.r1: Pick the car number (1-10) for this rank; match to win.
carno.eg: Bet 5; the rank draws car 5 → win.

quwei.title: Fun
quwei.r1: Bet on car numbers; match to win.

lm.title: Both Sides
lm.r1: Big/Small, Odd/Even, Prime/Composite of the rank's number.
lm.r2: Dragon/Tiger: compare this rank with its paired rank.
lm.eg: Bet Big; the rank's number is high → win.

gyhlm.title: Sum Both Sides
gyhlm.r1: Big/Small, Odd/Even of the champion + runner-up sum.

gyh.title: Sum Value
gyh.r1: Sum of champion + runner-up car numbers (3-19).

dn.title: Bull Bull
dn.r1: Five car numbers form a bull type: Niu Niu / Niu 1-9 / No Bull.
dn.eg: Bet Niu Niu; the five form Niu Niu → win.
